heroDesc:
For organisations looking to deliver meaningful wellbeing initiatives. For wellness brands seeking expert botanical insight. For sports clubs, spas and health spaces that want to offer trusted, evidence-informed support to their clients.
I work with organisations that value credible expertise, practical education and a thoughtful approach to natural health.
whyDesc1:
There is no shortage of wellness content. What organisations often need is expertise they can trust.
I provide consultancy, education and content grounded in clinical practice and professional training in herbal medicine and naturopathy. Whether I'm speaking to a team, supporting a brand or creating educational resources, my aim is always the same: to deliver information that is accurate, practical and genuinely useful.
